shortDescription: Japan’s S&P Global Composite PMI Business Activity Index held at 52.3 in October 2026, unchanged from the final reading for September, flash data showed.It was the 19th consecutive month of private-sector expansion, remaining at the slowest growth since May.

title: Japan Composite PMI Stays at 4-Month Low
